choices.topic: Chi-square for antibiotics: how are missing answers treated?
choices.opus: Left out patients with no recorded value from the test: p = 0.156.
choices.sonnet: Counted missing as 'no' in the test: p = 0.128.
choices.authors: Not known; the printed p<0.001 cannot be produced by standard tests.
choices.matters: Both models miss the antibiotic p-value (1 cell each); the printed value looks wrong.

choices.topic: How to read a duration typed as '17h'?
choices.opus: Read it as 17 hours, keeping all 126 non-invasive ventilation babies.
choices.sonnet: Treated it as unreadable and dropped that baby (125 babies).
choices.authors: Kept the value as 17 hours, judging by the published p-value.
choices.matters: Sonnet: duration p-value (0.0004 vs 0.0003 published). Opus: none.

choices.topic: How are babies with several viruses counted?
choices.opus: A baby counts for every virus named in its result; blank results count as not positive.
choices.sonnet: Same: any mention counts, co-infections count in each virus; blank counts as negative.
choices.authors: Not known; printed counts cannot be produced from the deposited virus results by any rule.
choices.matters: Both models: 12 virus count cells each; the table disagrees with the deposited data.

choices.topic: Round figures normally, or cut extra digits off?
choices.opus: Reported exact values, which round up (38.9, 1.75, 0.495, 3.75).
choices.authors: Cut the extra digits off: 38.9 became 38, 1.75 became 1.7, 0.495 became 0.49, 3.75 became 3.7.
choices.matters: Both models: 4 cells (antibiotic percent, PIM 2 SD and p-value, ventilation days lower quartile).

choices.topic: Chi-square test with or without Yates' correction?
choices.opus: With Yates' correction (R default for 2x2 tables).
choices.sonnet: With Yates' correction (R default for 2x2 tables).
choices.authors: Plain chi-square test without Yates' correction.
choices.matters: Both models: 3 p-values (female, previous wheezing, previous respiratory hospitalisation).

choices.topic: How is the 'initial' breathing score defined?
choices.opus: Initial FiO2, WDF and SpO2 are the 0 hour readings.
choices.sonnet: Initial values are the 0 hour columns.
choices.matters: Both models miss 3 initial WDF cells (two SDs, p-value); cause unknown.

choices.sonnet: R default (type 7, linear interpolation); SD with n - 1.
choices.matters: Both models miss 3 duration cells; cause unknown, no quartile method tried fits.

choices.topic: Which version of the Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney test?
choices.opus: Normal approximation with continuity correction (R default with ties); mean (SD) rows tested the same way.
choices.sonnet: Same: asymptotic with continuity correction; mean (SD) rows use Wilcoxon.

choices.topic: Percentages: whole group or patients with a value?

choices.opus: Sedated when the sedation-days field holds a number; 'nc' (empty) means not sedated.
choices.sonnet: Sedated when sedation days has a numeric value; 'nc' means not sedated.

choices.topic: Duration rows: include patients who never had it?
choices.opus: Summarised only patients with a numeric value; 'nc' and missing excluded, not coded as 0 days.
choices.sonnet: Same: numeric values only; rejected treating 'nc' as 0.
